name: Irene Appleyard
original_name: イレーヌ・アップルヤード
source:
A maid in the castle, she's actually Gilbert's childhood friend. Has a calm and gentle personality.

She's a good advisor to Lithia, but she's also a playful woman who gets excited when it comes to romance.
She has keen insight and observation skills, and can easily detect people's subtle emotions and lies.

[Translated from [url=http://magichouse.uh-oh.jp/11ningyo_3.html]official website[/url]]
